spaces.name: foundations
spaces.use_when: names/scopes, expressions, composition, mapping, temporal shape, entities, pipeline stages
spaces.skip_when: per-crate API surface (see apis); per-variant DataKind behavior (see data-kinds); engine mapping (see registry)

spaces.name: data-kinds
spaces.use_when: DataKind taxonomy, Dataset/Grainset/Unionset/Joinset variant behavior, applicability/nesting matrices
spaces.skip_when: cross-cutting foundations (see foundations); crate APIs (see apis)

spaces.name: apis
spaces.use_when: per-crate public contract, semver policy, crate boundaries, API stability

spaces.name: testing
spaces.use_when: behavioral contract gates, quality gates, test harness philosophy
spaces.skip_when: per-leaf testing strategies (see each leaf's ## Testing Strategy section); unit test details (see crate code)

spaces.name: registry
spaces.use_when: engine-specific mappings, types/functions/temporal/join mapping per engine
spaces.skip_when: canonical type/function/temporal definitions (see foundations); adapter API contract (see apis)

spaces.name: questions
spaces.use_when: decision lifecycle, open/closed/deferred question state, ratification history
